headline: Automotive Stampings and Assemblies appoints Vinod Chandak as Head of Purchase
hook: New purchase head takes charge at ASAL
summary: Automotive Stampings and Assemblies Limited has announced a change in its senior management. Mr. Vinod Chandak has been appointed as the Senior Management Personnel and Head of the Purchase Department. This internal leadership update affects procurement operations at the auto component maker. Indian retail investors tracking the company should note routine management changes in micro-cap automotive suppliers.
why_it_matters: Routine management shift with minimal direct impact on stock price.
